notes.title: Devlog #25 - New Career Mode
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]Today we’ve got something really exciting to share – we’re working on a **brand new Career Mode**, the biggest gameplay expansion for *Arena Renovation* so far.[/p][p]
[/p][p]## Career Mode – Build Your Own Business[/p][p]
[/p][p]Until now, *Arena Renovation* has been all about renovating sports facilities. With Career Mode, we’re taking things a big step further – you’ll become the owner of a growing company, starting from small renovation contracts and working your way up to managing entire sports complexes.[/p][p]
[/p][p]### What’s Coming?[/p][p]
[/p][p]🔨 **Sports Facility Contracts** – begin with smaller renovation and maintenance jobs to build up your reputation and unlock access to larger projects.[/p][p]
[/p][p]🛠️ **Purchasing Equipment** – to grow your business, you’ll need better tools and machines. Career Mode will allow you to invest in equipment that speeds up your work and unlocks new types of tasks.[/p][p]
[/p][p]🏟️ **Investing in Sports Venues** – you won’t just renovate facilities for others; you’ll also be able to **buy them for yourself**! Once you own them, it’s up to you to decide how to use and improve the space.[/p][p]
[/p][p]🎉 **Hosting Events** – on your renovated and owned arenas, you’ll be able to organize sports and cultural events. This adds a whole new layer to the game – not just renovation, but also management and planning events that attract crowds and boost your profits.[/p][p]
[/p][p]## Why Career Mode?[/p][p]
[/p][p]We wanted *Arena Renovation* to go beyond cleaning and restoring venues. Many of you suggested that it would be awesome to take things further and really feel like you’re building something lasting. With Career Mode, you’ll get to grow your business, invest strategically, and make decisions that shape the success of your company.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Let us know in the comments what excites you most – business growth, buying venues, or organizing events? 🎤💡[/p][p]
[/p][p]See you in the next devlog! 👷‍♂️✨[/p][p]
[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/ec1b02a20dbbc6345722f2534ab03c029e0d5ff5.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #24 Game, Set, Love...?
notes.content:
You didn't expect that, huh?

Like we've said - our game is not only about football stadiums. 
We have something for everything!

Today we want to introduce to you our blessed by King Richard himself - tennis area!

If you are a fan of Open Era, know what a Bagel is and are perfectly aware why a Fault has happened, you will be really pleased by what we prepared for you.
Again, you won’t be bored with stuff we have prepared for you this time!

But this week we have some photos from the beginnings of your mission!

First thing first - let's see what do we deal with, alright?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/1e7ce607107a45ef186741b533fa628778166c04.png[/img]

Oh, damn - why is it so dark in here? Let's go find some electricity to lighten up this place, shall we?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/240d3a58ec316ba656d4b3661d345693b1af2dcf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/24b30435b45b7bd17a7b7e1a8820c7c17e11bdb6.png[/img]

Need to go to through the lockers! Okay, but what's with the benches again?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/1ac5097800add2993f3b8519b7830e1f6edd3b93.png[/img]

Almost the... oops! Wrong room! Also - damn, this needs some plastering - look at this raw wall!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/a2b79bbbf8c70388ce8f05f4510d0cd597197678.png[/img]

There we go! Let's put some light on this place!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/1715e824bb9323af7f53395dc036103a2d2c6c61.png[/img]

Okay whoa! We got some work to do here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/17a62801280c18cef6f2ebdddc01cb296ca00b98.png[/img]

Some different angles before we begin!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/65a8d917389159923b5d93fc09b0b4df8c38d482.png[/img]

So now we got this out of the system and ready for some plastering, and refurbishing - stay tuned for next parts!

notes.title: Devlog #23 Of updates, renovations and basketball...
notes.content:
...wait BASKETBALL?

Well yes indeed - don't you forget it's about renovating Stadiums in general :D

SO! Long time no talk, but we're fully excused with our update absence, but we were so immersed in polishing and creating new spaces, and we would love to show you EVERYTHING we're currently working on, but one step at a time okay? :D

Today we come to you with some WIP basketball court- as you can see we made sure you will have plenty of items and objects to destroy and renovate.

So let us go through some of the screens, shall we?

So this is what you might find in the beginning - looks pretty sad and depressing, huh?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/2727e474d44e19ab486c3d791a58870504dd21b3.png[/img]

This looks like some serious cross fit workout with those benches all over the place. Anyone fancy some caber toss training?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/071cc2debbd46c11ecdd5632a47461eb244f17af.png[/img]

Okay, we can understand benches, but whole base??
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/16fd0490882d3cd9ba5a10b74ea3f8561a02b515.png[/img]

You can almost hear the sound of points and some pretty neat slam dunk going on here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/d4cbe4403efb642324580168125587a2ceabb342.png[/img]

Okay, enough of that - let's go visit other rooms!

Now this looks like somebody did some barricading here
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/5360302bad4e8a61169b70cd3827c6cebb82593c.png[/img]

Yup, definitely looks like a barricade
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/d1a5a2da4a0cc376351cb71ed412105b02d5ce13.png[/img]

Okay, but imagine the possibilities you can achieve in this space!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/c6f087161f08e28d48f94da59f999061f414d233.png[/img]

And the last, but (we think) the most important - locker rooms.
Now this room truly will need some good old putty on those walls
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/f86e4233d370d160c64b6ad04a4773ad745155a8.png[/img]

Okay that's it for now. Wwe're back with some more content this time.

notes.content:
[h1]Hello there Renovators! [/h1]
Let’s have a look at some development progress in our game. This time we would like to show you one of our stadiums - City Park Stadium.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/ab161b6e7cc6472cad20b19309409798aaf19f18.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/ab161b6e7cc6472cad20b19309409798aaf19f18.jpg[/img][/url]

We thought about the place, where we can connect both city areas and some green space
That’s why we decided to put the stadium in City park. 

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/2839e4a89a34f2f5ffd6640c437fb9a1eaa495b3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/2839e4a89a34f2f5ffd6640c437fb9a1eaa495b3.jpg[/img][/url]

What about the stadium size? It’s not the biggest object which you can find in game, however there might be a lot of work to do ( good luck Renovators! ). You can find there light reflectors and almost  8000 chairs to modify! (Chill, you can clean them faster than you expect).

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/7ed9c737df07cbc75ca8af509ff747f00ea4ecc9.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/7ed9c737df07cbc75ca8af509ff747f00ea4ecc9.jpg[/img][/url]

We’re still working on one of the most interesting mechanics in the game - stadium machines. On screenshots you can find the mower - the vehicle you’ll use the most. Stadium Renovator offers you different upgrades to your vehicles depending on which one you need at the moment. We’ll get back to that one in next dev logs.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/a83c87191ef2e13990cef0e4742c2a659641f038.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33646252/a83c87191ef2e13990cef0e4742c2a659641f038.jpg[/img][/url]
